description: This Java class defines a business event for undoing re-amortization of a loan within the Fineract system. It extends a base loan event class and primarily provides a specific event type identifier.

classes.name: LoanUndoReAmortizeBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event indicating that the re-amortization of a loan has been undone.

methods.name: LoanUndoReAmortizeBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a loan object.

methods.name: getType
